hints.content: Therefore, we can set up equivalent proportions and solve for $y$.

$\dfrac{\red{y}}{\blue{37.5}} = \dfrac{\red{16.5}}{\blue{27.5}}$

 Note: As each corresponding $\dfrac{\red{\text{side}}}{\blue{\text{side}}}$ proportion is equivalent, you could use the other sides (i.e., $\dfrac{\red{y}}{\blue{37.5}} = \dfrac{\red{12}}{\blue{20}}$)

Reduce the proportion on the right hand side.

 $\dfrac{\red{y}}{\blue{37.5}} = \cancel{\dfrac{\red{16.5}}{\blue{27.5}}}{\green{\dfrac{3}{5}}}$

Multiply each side by $37.5$ and simplify.

 $\cancel{37.5} \times \dfrac{\red{y}}{\cancel{\blue{37.5}}} = \green{\dfrac{3}{5}} \times 37.5$
